collection.title: VW Crafter 2006 to 2016 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a VW Crafter 2006 - 2016 model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 24" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Crafter which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
